content.Revascularization in patients with SCAD: Spontaneous coronary artery dissection has been managed conservatively or with revascularization. Long-term outcomes and treatment methods are explored, referencing articles by Jamil, Lettieri, Lobo, Martins, Tweet, Hayes, Saw, and others.
content.Revascularization in patients with Cardi: Different studies investigate the impact of drug-eluting stents, systemic inflammation, metabolic syndromes and various interventions on cardiac allograft vasculopathy. Notable contributors include Agrawal, Raichlin, Kobashigawa, Srivastava, Schmauss, and others.
content.Revascularization in patients with Anoma: Articles by Angelini and Cheezum explore coronary arteries with inappropriate sinuses of valsalva, focusing on clinical presentation and guidelines.
content.Radial and Femoral Approaches for PCI: The document discusses the differences and outcomes of radial versus femoral access for coronary interventions, with studies by Romaguoli, Valgimigli, Andó, and others providing insights.
